verdict.line: You lose if you let his W (Frenzied Maul) land twice on you and his attack-speed passive snowball an extended trade; you win if you force the fight on your Q-stack stun and W charge before his sustain kicks in.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's W (Path Maker) takes reduced damage while charging before it knocks back and stuns, which lets him walk straight through Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) engage and flip the stun back onto him - that's the structural reason K'Sante holds lane and solo-kill advantage (49.6% over 123 games) despite Volibear's higher sustain. The catch is Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) recast heals him and his passive attack speed scales every fight he's allowed to extend, so the matchup stays even once both sides are 6+.

theirWindow.when: levels 1-2, before your W is ranked
theirWindow.what: Your skill order takes Q then E before W, so until level 3 you have no stun to answer his Q (Thundering Smash) gap-close. Don't stand in his 300-range Q threat range to farm; let him burn it on a dodge or trade from outside it.

yourWindow.when: you land 2 Q stacks and have W off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Q (Ntofo Strikes) at 2 stacks fires a shockwave that pulls him in - chain that straight into W's charge-up (damage reduced while charging) and stun. This is your all-in window; take it rather than trading autos.

start.why: 90.7% pick rate and the magic resist answers Volibear's passive, which eventually adds bonus magic damage to his attacks - you want that online before his autos start ticking extra.

boots.why: 52.9% pick rate; the tenacity shortens how long his Q (Thundering Smash) stun locks you down, and the bonus MR stacks with Doran's Helm against his passive proc damage.

core.why: magic resist and the burst shield directly blunt his passive's magic damage proc and his Sky Splitter poke
the slow on-hit and cooldown reduction let your Q stack faster, which is your main engage-into-W tool
stacking resistances scale your trades as the lane goes even into mid game

situational.when: he's building attack speed and leaning on his W (Frenzied Maul) recast heal to win extended trades
he's ahead and threatening to all-in off his passive attack speed stacking
his attack speed snowball is making extended duels unwinnable

runes.keystoneWhy: sustains you through his early Q-stun poke and scales bonus health, which directly counters a champion whose passive and W recast both reward him for winning long trades

summoners.why: 73.2% pick rate; Teleport lets you reset after even trades and answer his Stormbringer-enabled tower dives on other lanes. Flash+Ignite (52.8% win rate over fewer games) is the stronger pick if you want to punish his lower-mobility all-ins directly.

playing.title: Hold Q for the pull, not poke
playing.detail: Don't spend both Q (Ntofo Strikes) casts just for chip damage - the second cast at 2 stacks fires a shockwave that pulls him in, which is what sets up your W stun. Waste the stacks and you lose your engage tool.

playing.title: Trade only with W up before level 6
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) reduces damage taken while charging, then knocks back and stuns - starting a trade with it ready lets you walk through his Q engage instead of eating it clean.

playing.title: Respect levels 1-2 without W
playing.detail: Your skill order (QEWQQR...) delays W to level 3. Until then you have no answer to his Q stun, so avoid standing in his 300-range engage threat.

playing.title: Disengage before his second W hit
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's recast on the same target deals bonus damage and heals him - if he's already landed one W on you, back off rather than letting him confirm the recast.

playing.title: Force the all-in around level 6-8
playing.detail: R (All Out) knocks him through walls and then transforms your kit with more damage and healing. This is your best window to commit to a kill before his sustain scales further.

playing.title: Don't facecheck past level 1 for his E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter has 1200 range and slows on hit while shielding him if he's in the blast - stay off cooldown-timer guesswork and just don't overextend past minions when it's up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live K'Sante vs Volibear top-lane games on the current patch via OP.GG; the power-curve timing and trade-pattern reasoning are my own read of the ability mechanics, not measured data.
